explanation: The statement concerns the library's own definition `TauCeti.vertexPreReflectionList` (a product of simple reflections along a word), so it has no counterpart in Mathlib. I checked whether it follows from a generic monoid lemma about flatten/replicate: Mathlib only has `List.prod_replicate`, `List.prod_flatten`, `List.prod_reverse` (Algebra/BigOperators/Group/List/Defs.lean), and Lean core only has `List.flatten_replicate_nil/_singleton/_replicate` and `prod_replicate_nat/_int`; there is no lemma of the form `(List.replicate N l).flatten` prod = `l.prod ^ N` (nor for a mapped product). Deriving the target from those would require unfolding the definition and rewriting reverses/maps with several steps, so it is neither a duplicate nor a short special case.
